about: The collecta of the formulary “Transferred Fifth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we beseech You to keep Your household continually under Your mercy: that as it leans only upon the hope of Your heavenly grace, so it may always be protected by Your mighty power. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
